description: Calendly tools an agent can be given: read the user, event types, open and busy times, availability, scheduled meetings, invitees and no-shows; book a meeting, create a single-use scheduling link, cancel a meeting, and mark or unmark a no-show, each write governed and read back where Calendly allows.

secrets.name: CALENDLY
secrets.description: The connected Calendly personal access token

actions.name: get-current-user
actions.description: Get the Calendly user the token belongs to: name, email, timezone, scheduling_url, and the uri and current_organization uri. The other actions take this user's uri (resource.uri) as user. The last part of any Calendly uri is the uuid the get actions take.

actions.name: list-event-types
actions.description: List one user's event types (the kinds of meeting people can book), 10 per page, by name: name, duration, active, kind, pooling_type, scheduling_url, locations, custom_questions and uri. Pass active=true to leave out inactive ones. Calendly returns pagination.next_page_token when there are more; pass it as page_token.

user.description: The user's uri, as get-current-user returns it in resource.uri (https://api.calendly.com/users/<uuid>).

active.description: true for active event types, false for inactive ones. Leave out for both.

page_token.description: pagination.next_page_token from the previous page. Leave out for the first page.

actions.name: get-event-type
actions.description: Get one event type: name, duration and duration options, active, kind, pooling_type, scheduling_url, locations, custom_questions (the questions a booking must answer), description and owner profile.

event_type_uuid.description: The event type's uuid: the last part of its uri (https://api.calendly.com/event_types/<uuid>), from list-event-types.

actions.name: list-available-times
actions.description: List the open start times of one event type between start_time and end_time, each with status, invitees_remaining and a scheduling_url that books it. Calendly requires start_time not in the past and a range of at most 31 days. Not paged: every slot in the range comes back, so keep the range to a week or less to stay under the 64 KB response limit.

event_type.description: The event type's uri, from list-event-types (https://api.calendly.com/event_types/<uuid>).

start_time.description: Start of the range, UTC ISO 8601 (2026-11-02T09:00:00Z). Not in the past.

end_time.description: End of the range, UTC ISO 8601. After start_time, and at most 31 days after it.

actions.name: list-busy-times
actions.description: List a user's busy times between start_time and end_time, in order: Calendly meetings, reserved times and events on connected calendars, each with start, end and buffered times. Calendly allows a range of at most 7 days, not in the past. External calendar events come from calendars with "Check for conflicts" turned on. Not paged.

user.description: The user's uri, as get-current-user returns it in resource.uri (https://api.calendly.com/users/<uuid>).

start_time.description: Start of the range, UTC ISO 8601 (2026-11-02T09:00:00Z). Not in the past.

end_time.description: End of the range, UTC ISO 8601. After start_time, and at most 7 days after it.

actions.name: list-availability-schedules
actions.description: List a user's availability schedules (their working hours): name, timezone, whether it is the default, and its rules by weekday and by date. Not paged.

user.description: The user's uri, as get-current-user returns it in resource.uri (https://api.calendly.com/users/<uuid>).

actions.name: list-scheduled-events
actions.description: List the user's scheduled meetings, 20 per page: name, status, start and end time, event_type, location, invitee counts, hosts and cancellation. Filter by status, by an invitee's email, and by start time (min_start_time and max_start_time, UTC). Sort by start time with sort. The user must be the token's own user. Calendly returns pagination.next_page_token when there are more; pass it as page_token.

user.description: The user's uri, as get-current-user returns it in resource.uri (https://api.calendly.com/users/<uuid>).

status.description: active or canceled. Leave out for both.

invitee_email.description: Only meetings with an invitee who has this email address.

min_start_time.description: Only meetings that start after this time, UTC ISO 8601.

max_start_time.description: Only meetings that start before this time, UTC ISO 8601.

sort.description: start_time:asc for soonest first, start_time:desc for latest first.

page_token.description: pagination.next_page_token from the previous page. Leave out for the first page.

actions.name: get-scheduled-event
actions.description: Get one scheduled meeting: name, status, start and end time, event_type, location (with the join URL for a video call), invitee counts, hosts, guests, and the cancellation when it was canceled.

event_uuid.description: The scheduled event's uuid: the last part of its uri (https://api.calendly.com/scheduled_events/<uuid>), from list-scheduled-events.

actions.name: list-event-invitees
actions.description: List the invitees of one scheduled meeting, 20 per page, oldest booking first: name, email, status, timezone, answers to the booking questions, no_show, and the cancel and reschedule URLs. Filter by status or email. Calendly returns pagination.next_page_token when there are more; pass it as page_token.

event_uuid.description: The scheduled event's uuid: the last part of its uri (https://api.calendly.com/scheduled_events/<uuid>), from list-scheduled-events.

status.description: active or canceled. Leave out for both.

email.description: Only the invitee with this email address.

page_token.description: pagination.next_page_token from the previous page. Leave out for the first page.

actions.name: get-invitee
actions.description: Get one invitee of a scheduled meeting: name, email, status, timezone, answers to the booking questions, rescheduled state, cancellation, payment, the cancel and reschedule URLs, and no_show (its uri when the invitee is marked as a no-show, otherwise null).

event_uuid.description: The scheduled event's uuid: the last part of its uri (https://api.calendly.com/scheduled_events/<uuid>), from list-scheduled-events.

invitee_uuid.description: The invitee's uuid: the last part of its uri (.../scheduled_events/<event uuid>/invitees/<uuid>), from list-event-invitees.

actions.name: get-no-show
actions.description: Get one no-show mark: its uri, the invitee it is on and when it was made. get-invitee returns the mark's uri in no_show.uri.

no_show_uuid.description: The no-show mark's uuid: the last part of no_show.uri from get-invitee (https://api.calendly.com/invitee_no_shows/<uuid>).

actions.name: book-meeting
actions.description: Book a meeting on an event type for one invitee, at a start time from list-available-times. Calendly sends its usual confirmation and calendar invite to the invitee and any guests, and runs the event type's workflows, as for a booking made on the booking page. Answer every required custom question of the event type (get-event-type) in answers, and give a location of a kind the event type offers. Read back from the user's active meetings with this invitee's email, latest first; the booked meeting must be among them. Limitation: Calendly's Scheduling API, which this uses, needs a paid plan (Standard or above); a Free plan answers 403. Limitation: the read-back looks among the token user's own meetings (user), so a booking on an event type the token user does not host reads back as a mismatch. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can book a second meeting.

event_type.description: The event type's uri, from list-event-types (https://api.calendly.com/event_types/<uuid>).

start_time.description: The meeting's start, UTC ISO 8601, as list-available-times returns it in start_time.

invitee_email.description: The invitee's email address. Calendly sends the confirmation here.

invitee_timezone.description: The invitee's IANA time zone, for example America/New_York or Europe/London.

user.description: The token user's uri (get-current-user, resource.uri), used to read the booking back. It must host this event type.

location.description: Where the meeting happens. Leave out to let Calendly use the event type's own location. It must be a kind the event type offers, and is not allowed for a round-robin event type.

kind.description: The location kind, one of those the event type offers.

location.description: The address for physical, the phone number for outbound_call, or the text for ask_invitee and custom. Leave out for the other kinds.

answers.description: Answers to the event type's custom questions. Each question must match the question text exactly.

question.description: The question, exactly as get-event-type returns it in custom_questions.

guest_emails.description: Email addresses of guests to invite as well, at most 10 (Calendly's limit). Each guest gets the invite.

actions.name: create-scheduling-link
actions.description: Create a single-use scheduling link for one event type and return its booking_url. One meeting can be booked with it, then it stops working. Creating it tells nobody; the link reaches a person when it is sent. No read-back: Calendly has no call that reads a scheduling link.

event_type.description: The event type's uri, from list-event-types (https://api.calendly.com/event_types/<uuid>).

actions.name: cancel-event
actions.description: Cancel one scheduled meeting, with a reason. Calendly notifies the invitees. Read back from the meeting; its status must be canceled and its cancellation reason this one. Limitation: Calendly has no call that undoes a cancellation; the invitee has to book again. Limitation: a meeting that was already canceled with the same reason reads back as a match.

event_uuid.description: The scheduled event's uuid: the last part of its uri (https://api.calendly.com/scheduled_events/<uuid>), from list-scheduled-events.

reason.description: Why the meeting is canceled. Calendly stores it on the meeting's cancellation.

actions.name: mark-no-show
actions.description: Mark one invitee of a meeting as a no-show. Read back from the invitee; its no_show must be the mark this call made. Limitation: an invitee already marked is refused by Calendly.

event_uuid.description: The scheduled event's uuid: the last part of its uri (https://api.calendly.com/scheduled_events/<uuid>), from list-scheduled-events.

invitee_uuid.description: The invitee's uuid: the last part of its uri (.../scheduled_events/<event uuid>/invitees/<uuid>), from list-event-invitees.

actions.name: unmark-no-show
actions.description: Remove a no-show mark from an invitee. Give the mark's uuid and the invitee it is on (get-no-show returns the invitee's uri). Read back from the invitee; its no_show must be empty. mark-no-show undoes it.

no_show_uuid.description: The no-show mark's uuid: the last part of no_show.uri from get-invitee.

event_uuid.description: The uuid of the meeting the invitee belongs to, for the read-back.

invitee_uuid.description: The uuid of the invitee the mark is on, for the read-back.

policies.name: calendly: approve removing a no-show mark

limits.name: calendly: no-show marks removed per day
